ev.q: Freeflow Combat was way ahead of its time
move without being seen and hunt enemies
by solving intricate puzzles with the help of cutting edge forensic tools
Explore every inch of Arkham Asylum and roam freely on the infamous island
Linear / on rails most of the time
Great story, characters, and voice acting
The story keeps you on the edge of your seat
presented for the first time ever in its gritty and realistic entirety
the game still holds up visually
Combat is incredibly clunky and unresponsive
the KBM controls are absolutely spaz
